items.statement:
For the standard first-strand cyclotomic quotient of a real symmetrizable KLR
datum over any degree-zero field and every homogeneous (Q1)–(Q4) parameter
family, put $A=R^\Lambda(\beta)$, $B=R^\Lambda(\beta+\alpha_i)$,
$e=e(\beta,i)$, $X=Be$, $Y=eB$,
$h=\langle h_i,\Lambda-\beta\rangle$ and $t=2d_i(1-h)$.
There are explicit, compatible homogeneous maps
$$T_i:eBe\longrightarrow A,\qquad \deg T_i=t,$$
and finite homogeneous tensors
$$C_i=\sum_\alpha x_\alpha\otimes_A y_\alpha\in X\otimes_A Y,\qquad \deg x_\alpha+\deg y_\alpha=-t,$$
such that $T_i$ is an $A$-bimodule map, $bC_i=C_ib$ for every $b\in B$, and
$$x=\sum_\alpha x_\alpha T_i(y_\alpha x),\qquad y=\sum_\alpha T_i(yx_\alpha)y_\alpha.$$
In particular $X\{t\}\cong\operatorname{HOM}_A(Y,A)$ as $(B,A)$-bimodules,
where Hom is left-$A$-linear, the left $B$-action is precomposition with
right multiplication on $Y$, and the right $A$-action is multiplication on
values. The second unit is $b\mapsto bC_i$ and the second counit is
$y\otimes_B x\mapsto T_i(yx)$, giving
$E_i\{t\}\dashv F_i\dashv E_i$ on all graded modules. They are obtained by
finite normal-form/cap transport, not by assuming an actual Frobenius trace.
Dots and same-color crossing mates have the native cyclic normalization.
Each specified distinguished-$i$ different-color sideways pair has both
composites $t_{ij}$ times the identity. The separately distinguished-$j$
construction has both composites $t_{ji}$ times the identity. These are
different partial actions, not two different scalar values for the two
orders of one pair; their full word-closure comparison is not inferred here.
Arbitrary monic field specializations have the same ungraded construction,
with grading shifts forgotten. No finite-type, characteristic-zero,
geometric-global-basis or symmetric-trace premise is used.

items.statement:
For the standard first-strand cyclotomic KLR quotient over any degree-zero
field, any real symmetrizable datum, and every homogeneous (Q1)–(Q4)
parameter family, fix $B=R^\Lambda(\beta)$ and put
$t_\beta=(\beta,\beta)-2(\Lambda,\beta)$.
Compose the actual second caps of
[[lem-cyclotomic-klr-induction-restriction-bimodules-have-compatible-frobenius-dual-bases]]
along a word $\nu$ to obtain $\epsilon_\nu:e(\nu)Be(\nu)\to k$.
Then
$$\tau_\beta(a)=\sum_{\nu\in I^\beta}\epsilon_\nu(e(\nu)ae(\nu))$$
is homogeneous of degree $t_\beta$, and
$a\mapsto[b\mapsto\tau_\beta(ba)]$ is an isomorphism
$B\to DB\{-t_\beta\}$. This proves perfectness of the actual word form,
including off-diagonal corner pairings, without assuming that a nonzero
closure detects every ideal.
For the native crossing $p_\nu=\tau_re(\nu)$ with bottom adjacent colors
$(i,j)$, $i\ne j$, and the $i$ strand directed SW to NE,
$$\tau_\beta(p_\nu a)=(t_{ij}/t_{ji})\tau_\beta(ap_\nu),\qquad a\in e(\nu)Be(s_r\nu).$$
Dots, idempotents and same-color crossings have ratio $1$. The twofold
right-adjunction mate of $p_\nu$ has the same ratio to $p_\nu$; this is a
comparison of the actual separately constructed color adjunctions.
Choose a total order on the finite color support and set
$$c_\nu=\prod_{a<b,\,\nu_a>\nu_b}\frac{t_{\nu_a\nu_b}}{t_{\nu_b\nu_a}},\qquad c=\sum_\nu c_\nu e(\nu).$$
Then $\operatorname{tr}_\beta(a)=\tau_\beta(ca)$ is perfect and symmetric
of degree $t_\beta$, so $DB\cong B\{t_\beta\}$ as graded bimodules.
For a finite projective $P$,
$D_\psi P\cong P^\#\{t_\beta\}$.
For arbitrary monic field deformations the same actual constructions give
an ungraded perfect symmetric form; a homogeneous degree is not asserted.
On zero blocks the functional is zero and perfectness is vacuous. At rank
zero it is the identity on $k$; at one strand it is monic top-coefficient
extraction, of degree $-2d_i(\lambda_i-1)$ in the standard case.

items.statement:
For the standard homogeneous first-strand cyclotomic quotient over any field
and every homogeneous (Q1)-(Q4) datum, use basic right-append induction $F_i$
from $\beta$ to $\beta+\alpha_i$ and basic restriction $E_i$ in the reverse
direction. Put $h=\langle h_i,\Lambda-\beta\rangle$ and
$t_i(\beta)=2d_i(1-h)=(\alpha_i\mid\alpha_i)-2(\Lambda-\beta\mid\alpha_i)$.
Then there are explicit homogeneous bimodule units and counits with both
triangle identities giving $E_i\{t_i(\beta)\}\dashv F_i\dashv E_i$ on all
graded module categories. They preserve the standard dot-cyclic and same-color
crossing-mate identities and the coherent different-color double-mate
identity: for $p_\nu=\tau_re(\nu)$ with bottom adjacent colors $(i,j)$,
$i\ne j$, its double right mate is $(t_{ij}/t_{ji})p_\nu$, where $t_{ij}$ is
the coefficient of $u^{-a_{ij}}$ in $Q_{ij}(u,v)$ and the strand of color $i$
runs SW to NE. Equivalently the associated right closure satisfies
$\operatorname{cl}(p_\nu a)=(t_{ij}/t_{ji})\operatorname{cl}(ap_\nu)$ for
$a\in e(\nu)R^\Lambda(\beta)e(s_r\nu)$; dots, idempotents and equal-color
crossings have ratio $1$. The corresponding arbitrary monic field quotients
have the same underlying ungraded biadjunction and ordered crossing-mate
identities after forgetting internal shifts. No Frobenius, integral
Grothendieck-module or crystal theorem is a premise.

items.statement:
For the STANDARD graded cyclotomic quotient over any degree-zero field and
admissible graded real symmetrizable KLR datum, every block
$B=R^\Lambda(\beta)$ is finite-dimensional, all dots are nilpotent, and
$R^\Lambda(\beta+n\alpha_i)=0$ for large $n$. Put
$\operatorname{def}_\Lambda(\beta)=(\Lambda,\beta)-(\beta,\beta)/2$. A nonzero
block has a perfect symmetric homogeneous functional
$\operatorname{tr}_\beta:B\to k$ of degree
$t_\beta=-2\operatorname{def}_\Lambda(\beta)$; on a zero block perfectness is
vacuous and the functional is zero. Thus $DB\cong B\{t_\beta\}$ as graded
bimodules. For finite projective $P$, with
$P^\#=\operatorname{HOM}_B(P,B)^\psi$, one has
$D_\psi P\cong P^\#\{t_\beta\}$, so vector duality preserves projectives.
This does not assert $P^\#=P$ for every shifted projective, nor self-duality
of every indecomposable finite module. For arbitrary monic deformation
polynomials the separate conclusion is finite-dimensional and symmetric
UNGRADED, with finite root strings and monic dot annihilators; nilpotence and
homogeneous trace degree are not asserted. In rank one the standard trace is
the top coefficient on $k[x]/x^{\lambda_i}$ and has degree
$-2d_i(\lambda_i-1)$.
